questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

b _ c e _ k b _ c _ f k b b _ e f _ b b c _ f k

options.text: b, f, b, e, c, e, k
b, e, b, f, c, k, e
b, f, b, e, c, k, e
b, f, b, c, e, k, e

questions.solution:
Given: b _ c e _ k b _ c _ f k b b _ e f _ b b c _ f k

By checking options,

(1) b, f, b, e, c, e, k → b **b** c e **f** k - b **b** c **e** f k - b b **c** e f **e** - b b c **k** f k

(2) b, e, b, f, c, k, e → b **b** c e **e** k - b **b** c **f** f k - b b **c** e f **k** - b b c **e** f k

**(3) b, f, b, e, c, k, e →** *b **b** c e **f** k - b **b** c **e** f k - b b **c** e f **k **- b b c **e** f k*

 
• *Here, **'bbcefk'*** is repeated

(4) b, f, b, c, e, k, e → b **b** c e **f** k - b **b** c **c** f k - b b **e** e f **k** - b b c **e** f k

Only options (3) b, f, b, e, c, k, e forms pattern when substituted.

Hence, **b, f, b, e, c, k, e** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are NOT related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(7, 21, 49)
When number X multiplied to its next number, the product 1260 is obtained. When Number X is added to Number Y, a total of 106 is obtained. Find the value of Number Y. (Assume numbers to be positive)
questions.solution:
According to the question,

X × (X + 1) = 1260

X² + X - 1260 = 0

By solving the above equation we get,

X = 35 and - 36

⇒ X = 35 (as X is a positive number)

And,

X + Y = 106

⇒ Y = 106 - X

Y = 106 - 35

Y = 71

Hence, **71 **is the correct answer.

Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

21 ∶ 445 ∶∶ 24 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
Given: 21 ∶ 445 ∶∶ 24 ∶ ?

The logic followed here is: 

21 : 445 → 21 × 21 + 4 = 441 + 4 = 445

Similarly,

24 : ? → 24 × 24 + 4 = 576 + 4 = 580

Hence, **580 **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All dancers are talented.

Some girls are dancers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some girls are talented.

II. All talented are girls.

III. All girls are talented.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4a8c71dc36b32adec6ee55db3107671e17561e9fc20414dae44e31b11a91c36.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some girls are talented → True (as some girls are dancers and all dancers are talented, implies some girls who are dancers are talented too)

II. All talented are girls → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

III. All girls are talented → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

Hence, **only conclusion I follows.**
